blocks.text: Threats pehchanne ka matlab hai potential (ho sakne wale) online khatron ko pehchanna, jaise:

items: Phishing Scams: Yeh fraud (dhoke) ki koshishein hain jin mein koi bharose wali organization (jaise bank) ban kar sensitive (nijji aur qeemti) maloomat li jati hai. Misal: Un emails se hoshiyar rahein jo kisi jaani pehchani organization ki “urgent request (fauran jawab do wali darkhwast)” ke bahane personal details maangti hain.

Malware: Malicious (bure irade se bana, nuqsan pohanchane wala) software jo aap ke computer ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai ya data chura sakta hai. Misal: Untrusted (jin par bharosa na ho) jagahon se software download na karein aur apna antivirus software update rakhein.

blocks.prompt: Malware kya hai, aur is ka khatra kaise kam karein?
blocks.explanation: Harmful (nuqsan pohanchane wala) software jo computer ko kharab karta ya data churata hai. Software sirf bharose wali jagah se download karein aur antivirus update rakhein.

items: Khatre pehchanein: phishing scams (urgent request wali emails), malware (untrusted downloads se bachein; antivirus update).
